newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Penny stocks shine as Manila index ends down.
newsitem.headline: Penny stocks shine as Manila index ends down.

text.p: ------------------------- Feb 26 ---------------------------- * Property and mining issues defy market's drop
Speculative issues continued to soar in heavy trade on Wednesday, deying the general downtrend of the Philippine stock market, dealers said.

"Investors are taking heavy risks on penny stocks on hopes of better returns compared to blue-chips," said Monique Lecaros, a trader at Sun Hung Kai Securities. The main index ended 13.26 points lower at 3,349.82 following two days of rises.
Mining and property issues took most of the gains of the estimated four billion pesos worth of shares that changed hands.
Investors took profits on blue-chips due to lack of fresh incentives, traders said. "Local buyers flocked to speculatives that have storylines on new projects," said Lecaros.
Heavily-traded penny issues included Ebecom Holdings, which soared 32.86 percent to 93 centavos, and ATN Holdings, which leaped 21.87 percent to 9.75 centavos.
Traders said they expected the main index to hover slightly above its support of 3,300 for the rest of the week.
